entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Lutyens' Delhi is an area in New Delhi, India, named after the British architect Edwin Lutyens (1869–1944), who was responsible for much of the architectural design and building during the period of the British Raj, when India was part of the British Empire between the 1920s and 1940s. This also includes the Lutyens Bungalow Zone (LBZ).
